criteria.matches_direction: Barrel increases from 18 to 24 model units, crankcase/wheel move six forward. Complete square bed has eight casing slabs plus controller. Two supports retained; no invented middle pedestal.
criteria.geometry_uvs: Saddle posts terminate at y17, matching cap underside; top surfaces no longer coincide at y19. Rotating wheel stays above bed and inside footprint. Native exports validated; dedicated texture islands regenerate at native density.
criteria.material_consistency: Generated reference-driven surface sheet supplies steel corner protectors, brass pinstriped covers, inset support panels and muted enamel body bands. Explicit edge pixels articulate wheel/spokes. Front/rear native views inspected after modest panel brightening; shared casing and isolated gauge retained.
criteria.assembly_interfaces: Cylinder/flywheel anchors unchanged. Fuel moves front and lubricant underside, allowing filled front corners; native controller pedestal matches slab height. Front machinery row requires clearance.
criteria.animation_states: Native pose sheet and in-game motion show the complete wheel rotating about the translated pivot. Worst sweep clears bed by over 1.8 model units; wheel stays outside bearing housing. No new save/reopen regression claim.
criteria.native_size_readability: Panel details remain legible in native views and the actual Photon scene. Longer proportions retain the previous material density.
